title: Command Center first-run slate with action snippets and contextual config templates
creator: Sofia Patel
description: Design a compact, task-first empty slate for the Console 'Command Center' that helps new users get running in under five minutes. The slate combines short contextual explanations, three configurable starter snippets (Generate, Embed, Deploy), and one-click scaffold actions that create a sample project or route. Focus areas: reduce time-to-first-success, highlight cost/latency tradeoffs inline, and provide clear paths to advanced rollout tools.
problem_statement: New users land on a blank Console with little context. Current onboarding flows are linear and large; many users bounce before creating a first route or understanding cost implications. We need a lightweight 'init slate' that surfaces high-value starter actions and educates around rollout and cost without overwhelming the user.
goals: Decrease time-to-first-route creation to < 5 minutes for new users
Increase conversion from signup to active route creation by 18% in first 14 days
Surface cost/latency information at the point of action to reduce surprise billing tickets
constraints: Must reuse existing Console atoms/components (cards, hint-pill, action-sheet)
Backend needs endpoints for creating sample workspace artifacts (ENG-4521)
Privacy: sample data must be synthetic and not exported outside customer orgs
proposal_summary: Add a three-panel init slate: (1) Quick Actions (Generate, Embed, Deploy) with configurable presets and cost-estimate chips; (2) Guided Checklist with progressive disclosure and inline tooltips; (3) Learning Snippets with copyable code and a 'Run sample' action that provisions a sandbox route. Include an optional 'Preview real traffic' toggle that links to Dedicated trial docs.
proposed_variants: Variant A: Action-first with large primary CTA 'Create sample route'
Variant B: Education-first with inline micro-guides and step progression bar
Variant C: Minimal with only two actions + 'Learn more' expandable panel
acceptance_criteria: Init slate appears for first-time users in new workspaces
Quick Actions create the expected sample resources and return a success state within 20s in staging
Cost chips show estimated monthly token cost for selected preset and link to cost breakdown in Console
Tooltips are accessible (screen-reader friendly) and pass a11y contrast checks
Design reviewed and signed off by PM and Eng; implementation tickets created for ENG-4521 and ENG-4682
user_research: Remote moderated session with 6 new users (2 startups, 2 mid-market, 2 platform) — key insight: users wanted a single 'sample' flow they could trigger and then inspect
Unmoderated prototype test (n=120) — Variant A had 22% higher completion vs current baseline
implementation_notes: Eng to provide endpoint for sandbox provisioning (ENG-4521). If not available, fallback to client-side mock with clear 'demo mode' indicator
Use existing cost-estimate microservice; add endpoint param for preset defaults
Telemetry events: init_slate_shown, quick_action_clicked, sample_route_created (attach PRD telemetry map)
review_feedback: PM (Aisha Ramírez): prioritize 'Generate' and 'Deploy' order in the action row — customers care about sample outputs first
Eng (Rohit Patel): prefer server-side sample creation to avoid race conditions; estimated 3 sprint work (ENG-4521, ENG-4682)
Security (Nina Cho): sample artifacts must be labeled 'demo' and excluded from exports. Add an audit tag
decisions: Ship Variant A as the initial experiment with a follow-up A/B for Variant B after two weeks
Expose only three presets to keep cognitive load low: Balanced, Low-latency, Cost-saver
Defer 'Preview real traffic' integration to post-launch (dependency on Dedicated trial gating)
next_steps: Finalize Figma components and handoff tokens (design -> eng) — due 2026-03-12
Eng to implement provisioning endpoint and telemetry (sprint 27)
Create experiment dashboard in Console analytics to track conversion and cost-dispute events
